{{Top|leg}}
A '''rust inhibitor''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] upgrade that would help prevent rust from forming on a droid.<ref name="RCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> The [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]] had a rust inhibitor installed.<ref name="WDNTS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050120a|text=We Don't Need That Scum}}</ref>
